title: Roasted Masala Makhana
description: Crunchy fox nuts roasted in a little ghee and tossed with pepper, rock salt and chaat masala, a light evening snack.
steps: Heat the ghee in a wide pan on low heat.
Add the makhana and roast, stirring constantly, for 8 to 10 minutes until they turn crisp and a piece breaks easily.
Turn off the heat and sprinkle the black pepper powder, rock salt, chaat masala and red chilli powder.
Toss well to coat, cool for a few minutes and store airtight.
